events.title: Austin Trail of Lights
events.venue: Zilker Park (Grand Entrance on Barton Springs Rd)
events.ageLabel: All ages. Kids 11 and under free
events.schedule: Dec 10 to 23, 7 to 10pm. Free nights Dec 10, 11 and 13 to 17
events.priceLabel: Free on 7 nights. Other nights $8 ages 12+. Kids 11 and under free

registration.note: No ticket is needed on free nights. Paid nights are Dec 12 and 18 to 23. Parking must be bought online in advance, even on free nights. ZIP passes add 6pm early entry and are limited.

events.description: Holiday light displays fill Zilker Park for two weeks. Strollers and small wagons are welcome. Weeknights in the first week usually draw the smallest crowds.
events.sourceNote: 'The Trail of Lights runs December 10th - 23rd, 2026 from 7:00pm to 10:00 pm', $8 GA for ages 12+ on Dec 12 and 18-23, free GA Dec 10, 11 and 13-17 with 'No advance ticket is required for GA entry', ZIP/Platinum 6pm early entry with limited supply, prepaid online parking only ('No parking will be sold onsite'), strollers and small wagons allowed, accessibility early entry at 6pm via the Lou Neff Rd ADA entrance, Zilker Park address and the smallest-crowds tip (weekday in the week of 12/10) confirmed on austintrailoflights.org event FAQs, the free-night FAQ and the ticket types page. 'Children 11 and under are always free to enter with a ticketed adult' from the ticket types page. Passes went on sale 'the beginning of October' (no exact date). Sessions list Dec 10-21. Dec 22 and 23 also run.

events.title: Luminations
events.ageLabel: All ages. Kids 2 and under free
events.schedule: Select nights Nov 20 to Dec 31, entry 5:45 to 7:45pm
events.priceLabel: Adults $30, ages 3 to 12 $20, ages 2 and under free

registration.note: Buy timed tickets online in advance. Arrive no more than 15 minutes before your slot. Members pay $23 for adults and $13 for kids. Free parking with a shuttle is at St. Augustine's University.

events.description: Glowing garden paths and nightly live music at the botanic garden. Strollers and wagons are welcome. The exhibit stays lit until 9pm and closes Dec 24 and 25.
events.sourceNote: 'Nov. 20 - Dec. 31, 2026' with listed nights Nov 20-22, 27-29, Dec 3-6, 10-13, 17-23, 26-31, entry 5:45-7:45pm, exhibit ends 9pm, closed Dec 24-25, prices ($30/$23 member adults, $20/$13 member youth 3-12, children 2 and under free), 'Tickets must be purchased in advance', 15-minute early-arrival rule, strollers and wagons allowed, nightly live music, free offsite parking at St. Augustine's University (5401 La Crosse Ave) with shuttle every 15 minutes, $25 onsite parking and address confirmed on wildflower.org/luminations. Per-date event pages exist on the family-events calendar. No on-sale date or sold-out notice is printed. Status open is inferred from the Tickets link. Dec 3 is billed as UT Night.
